programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programs.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska
Martyna Wojciechowska's goal is Mexico.This is the country where most disappearances of women occur.Kidnapped or lured, they become part of one of the most profitable businesses - prostitution.The traveler visits the nursing home intended for them.Professional sex work is legal in Mexico, but women who engage in it cannot count on any pension or health benefits.At Casa Xochiquetzal, Martyna Wojciechowska talks to eighteen residents and the director of the home, who fights for them to age with dignity and to experience warmth.

Martyna Wojciechowska goes to South Africa, where she visits an unusual teenager, Ella Addison.Her greatest passion is diving with sharks.She first jumped into water full of predators when she was five years old.It was her parents, Gail and Mark, who taught the girl how to dive.Together with her godmother - Julie Andersen, the founder of Shark Angels, an organization that saves sharks - they also infected Ella with love for the ocean and these animals.The teenager is the voice of the young generation on saving the world.In 2018, as many as 150 million sharks were killed.Traders obtain their fins, which are the basic ingredient of the most expensive soup in the world.They throw the rest into the ocean, leaving the fish to die.Representatives of this species, on the one hand, have the worst reputation of all animals, and on the other hand, they are greatly underestimated.If they became extinct, the ecosystem would be disturbed.

programs.title: Man vs World
programs.desc: Rob Bell, an adventurer, athlete and engineer, sets off on a journey during which he will travel only in vehicles powered by human muscles.Every morning the traveler will take on a new challenge.Wanting to visit as many places as possible and reach the destination before sunset, he will learn about disciplines such as canyoning, paragliding, mountain biking, mountain kayaking, coasteering and mountainboarding.During the expedition, he will cover difficult areas of South Africa, Poland, the Czech Republic and Great Britain.He will also meet many guides who will give him advice on how to navigate the cliffs, slopes and river gorges.When Rob undergoes this endurance test, he will see the world from a completely new perspective.

programs.title: Mexico Life 3
programs.desc: The creators of the program follow people looking for their perfect home in Mexico.Most of them dream of constant sun, beautiful beaches and water sports.Some people are looking for an entertaining nightlife, while others are looking for the traditional cuisine of the region.There are also many people who want to live in a secluded and quiet place on the coast.Local real estate agents will help them make a choice and find their own place in Mexican paradise.In each episode, specialists will present the characters with numerous offers from the real estate market, both the more expensive ones, but ready to move in, and the cheaper ones, but requiring renovation.
